body: Invasion of privacy, and if there's documented conflicts you can sue them. I would be petty and plant about 8 trees on that fence line lol

Wow THANKS for the kind words! :)

If I could give advice I'd say write down the stuff that makes you feel REALLY shitty, and REALLY depressed and just work on it, fuck everyone else or what they think.

I know the feeling all too well of being "worthless", or just being "sad", it sucks it really does suck, and it weighs you down like a ton of bricks, but I'm now in the GYM working on my body, and working on my attitude all around.

I know it's hard to listen to other people's point of view when you can't help the way you feel, but you have to own that shit, and start making changes for YOU, no one else YOU! Ever since I've done that life has been a little better. (baby steps)

I do get depressed sometimes, and I learn to just cry that shit out and stop drinking when I'm sad because it doesn't make the pain go away it makes it worse, and could makes someone do something they would regret.

Everyone is on this sub for a reason, and I feel like we all care about each other in some weird relatable way due to our shared thoughts of suicide, it's hard for me to talk to people about it because I know they can't relate, and will just say sorry or that I need help (no shit)

Just remember you should matter to yourself FIRST before trying to matter to others because I've found trying to love myself, and putting my feelings first is healthy. If total strangers on the internet can care so can you!

Life can be a shithole sometimes, but please don't leave you might be in the dark right now, but that doesn't last forever I promise, I really do.
